high_level_description: This image features a beautifully decorated cake placed on a white plate with a blue rim, sitting on a glass table. The cake is adorned with yellow frosting that has been piped into intricate, petal-like designs around the top edge. The center of the cake is topped with two dollops of frosting, each sprinkled with small silver and red decorative beads. A single blue candle is inserted into the cake, standing upright. The background shows a patterned fabric with a mix of dark and light brown tones, featuring swirling and circular designs.
